owned_functions.abi: AAPCS A32: r0=VM address; r0=i32 result, zero on ordinary run capacity failure, one on completion
owned_functions.extent: 0x011a8818 inclusive through 0x011ab010 exclusive; final literal at 0x011ab00c belongs to this extent
owned_functions.byte_identity: Read exactly 10232 original image bytes at file offset 690200 and SHA-256 matched the source index. Original A32 disassembly inspected; no execution performed.

shared_core.storage: Caller-owned rows, morphology scratch, bitmap bytes, bounds and run consumer. No addresses, allocator or physical VM layout in shared core.
shared_core.errors: Portable storage propagates typed buffer/arithmetic faults. Physical A32 adapter uses Infallible memory operations and the existing arithmetic runtime.
shared_core.cutover: Original A32 export delegates to this shared core. Style, morphology, shear, orientation and pixel math are not duplicated in the adapter.
shared_core.portable_qualification: Source-only. Constructor-to-mask-to-graphics integration and joint verification remain unrun.

a32_corrections: The Ghidra flag8 divisions show a literal zero denominator. Actual ldr r1,[r4,#0x58] establishes height as denominator, including 0x011a96ac..0x011a96b8. Column shear divides by width at 0x011a96f8..0x011a9700.
Bitmap lookup masks are bytes, not the draft int table reads: 0x80,0x40,0x20,0x10,0x08,0x04,0x02,0x01 at 0x011ab9f4.
Style2 ignores run insertion failure and returns one. Its unsheared run-output tail calls merge_span(row,0,0). These behaviors are retained, not repaired.
Style2 row shear inserts into the run table even when output_kind selects bitmap. Column shear is not applied by style2.
source_domain_limits: Original code does not validate VM pointers, bitmap capacity, row-array bounds, expansion, width or height. Callers must supply accessible original-layout storage.

A reached division with zero width or height crosses the arithmetic runtime divide-by-zero boundary. No synthetic success or invented quotient is supplied here; compiler runtime and original runtime qualification remain required.
Ghidra C is NONMATCHING. Original A32, not undefined draft locals or pointer types, determines behavior.
scenario_contract: Independent literal nonzero two-row spans and bitmap bytes for all eight styles, row and column shear, rotation, clipping/origins, zero/partial/exact run capacity, style2 failure suppression, empty input and unknown styles. All application CPU helper calls execute source or owned functions, with no scripted calls or code-pointer table.
